nodes.description: msg.sender / _msgSender(), caller controlled address used for ownership, whitelist, claim and mint checks
block.timestamp, compared against PUBLIC_SALE_OPEN and PRIVATE_SALE_OPEN sale windows
uint256 public maxSupply, hard cap of mintable tokens
uint256 public maxPrivateQuantity, per-user private sale cap
uint256 public privatePrice, ETH price per private mint
uint256 public publicPrice, ETH price per public mint
uint256 NAME_CHANGE_PRICE, $SPLOOT amount burnt to rename a token
uint256 BIO_CHANGE_PRICE, $SPLOOT amount burnt to change a bio
PaymentMethod[4] PAYMENT_METHODS, token/decimals/publicPrice table for USDT, USDC, SHIBA, SPLOOT
ClaimableNft[2] Claimables, friendship NFT contracts and per-tokenId claimed flags
uint256 public totalClaimed, counter of claim mints performed
uint256 public maxClaimable, cap of claim mints
address internal adminImplementation, delegatecall target for all admin functions
IYieldTokenUpgradeable YIELD_TOKEN, external reward token contract
mapping(address=>bool) claimedAddresses, one-claim-per-wallet flag
mapping(address=>bool) claimableUcdHolders, UCD holder claim eligibility
mapping(address=>bool) _privateSaleWhitelist, private sale eligibility
mapping(address=>uint256) _privateQuantity, per-wallet private minted count
CountersUpgradeable.Counter _tokenIds, monotonic token id counter
string public baseTokenURI, base metadata URI
address public ADMIN, admin role holder
address payable public TREASURY, treasury role holder
mapping(string=>bool) _nameReserved, reserved name registry
uint256 constant PUBLIC_SALE_OPEN timestamp gating public mint/claim
uint256 constant PRIVATE_SALE_OPEN timestamp gating private mint
address constant UCD, claimable ERC20 token address
initialize(...) external initializer, sets all config, roles, payment methods and claimables
claim(address,uint256) external whenNotPaused, free mint path for UCD holders and friendship NFT holders
mint(uint256,uint256) external payable whenNotPaused, public sale mint supporting ETH and ERC20 payments
privateMint(uint256) external payable whenNotPaused, whitelist-only ETH private sale mint
_mintOne(address) internal, increments counter and mints a single token
getReward() external, triggers yield token reward settlement for msg.sender
changeBio(uint256,string) public virtual, burns BIO_CHANGE_PRICE and stores new bio
changeName(uint256,string) public virtual, validates, burns NAME_CHANGE_PRICE and updates reserved names
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public override, updates rewards then delegates to super
safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256,bytes) public override, updates rewards then delegates to super
tokenURI(uint256) public view override, concatenates baseTokenURI with tokenId
toLower(string) public pure, lowercases a string
validateName(string) public pure, character and length validation of names
isClaimedAlready(uint256,uint256) external view, reads Claimables claimed map
isWhitelisted(address) public view, reads _privateSaleWhitelist
isNameReserved(string) public view, calls toLower then reads _nameReserved
tokenNameByIndex(uint256) public view, returns stored token name
toggleReserveName(string,bool) internal, sets _nameReserved through toLower
getClaimables() external view, returns Claimables addresses plus UCD
reserve(uint256) external, admin entry point that delegatecalls to adminImplementation
setYieldToken(address) external, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
setProvenanceHash(string) external, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
updateBaseURI(string) external, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
updateMaxSupply(uint256) external, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
updateQuantity(uint256,uint256) external, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
updatePrice(uint256,uint256) external, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
updatePriceOfToken(uint256,uint256) external, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
pause() external virtual, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
unpause() external virtual, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
updateWhitelist(address[]) external, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
updateUcdHolders(address[]) external, admin entry point forwarding via delegateToAdmin
withdrawToTreasury() external onlyTreasury, forwards via delegateToAdmin
_toggleReserveName(string,bool) internal, second reserve-name setter
_burn(uint256) internal virtual override, burns token and clears token URI
delegateToAdmin() internal, executes adminImplementation.delegatecall(msg.data)
delegatecall to adminImplementation with fully attacker-influenced msg.data inside the proxy storage context
IERC20.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _totalPrice) external token call in mint
YIELD_TOKEN.burn(msg.sender, amount) external call in mint, changeBio and changeName
IERC721Enumerable(Claimables[i].token).ownerOf(_tokenId) external call in claim
unbounded-loop minting of _quantity tokens per transaction
unchecked counter increment _tokenIds.increment() on every mint
arithmetic multiplication of _quantity by publicPrice/privatePrice used for payment validation
arithmetic addition totalSupply().add(_quantity) and _privateQuantity[msg.sender].add(_quantity)
YIELD_TOKEN.updateRewardOnMint(msg.sender, amount) external call during mint/claim
YIELD_TOKEN.updateReward / getReward external calls on transfer and reward claim
IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received callback reached through _safeTransfer in safeTransferFrom
claim(address _claimableToken) parameter selecting UCD or friendship NFT claim path
claim(uint256 _tokenId) parameter, id of the friendship NFT used to claim
mint/privateMint uint256 _quantity parameter, number of tokens to mint
mint(uint256 _paymentMethodId) parameter indexing ETH or PAYMENT_METHODS entry

_mintOne(address _owner) parameter, recipient of the minted token
changeName(string newName) parameter, new token name to validate and reserve

setProvenanceHash(string) parameter forwarded to admin implementation

normalization_plan.reason: The claim selector parameter only carries data into the claim function; it has no standalone semantic identity outside claim's branch logic
The friendship NFT tokenId parameter is only meaningful as input to claim's ownership and claimed-checks
The mint quantity parameter belongs to mint's payment validation and mint loop semantics
The payment method index only selects the PAYMENT_METHODS entry inside mint
_totalPrice is a temporary multiplication result used solely within mint's payment checks
The _owner parameter is the direct recipient argument of the internal mint routine
newName has no meaning outside changeName and should collapse into that function
The admin address argument is consumed only by initialize when granting roles
The provenance hash argument is only forwarded from its admin entry point into the delegatecall
The yield token address argument is only forwarded from its admin entry point into the delegatecall
